paper_title: VisuoThink Empowering LVLM Reasoning with Multimodal Tree Search
caption: The performance gain (+%) on tasks through predictive rollout search. The performance gain is calculated via the performance gap between VisuoThink (w/o rollout search) and VisuoThink.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance gain, expressed as a percentage, achieved by using predictive rollout search within the VisuoThink system across four different models: Claude-3.5-Sonnet, GPT-4, Claude-40, and Qwen-72B-VL.  The horizontal axis represents the model names, arranged in left-to-right order, and the vertical axis represents the performance gain in percentage points, ranging from 0% to 30%, with tick marks spaced by 5%. The value axis is linear, beginning at 0 and ending at 30, with the units indicated as “(+%)”.  The bar corresponding to Claude-3.5-Sonnet is approximately 27% tall, the bar for GPT-4 is approximately 19% tall, the bar for Claude-40 is approximately 11% tall, and the bar for Qwen-72B-VL is approximately 6% tall. All bars are shaded in shades of purple, representing a gradient from “Strong Supervision” to “Weak Supervision”.  The bars are not sorted in any particular order; however, the bar for Claude-3.5-Sonnet is visually emphasized as the tallest bar in the chart.
